newsitem.title: POLAND: BWR plans to issue up to 20 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: BWR plans to issue up to 20 mln shares.

text.p: Polish Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej SA (BWR) said it plans to issue between 10,022,750 and 20 million shares, with part of the issue earmarked for Bank Secesyjny to conclude the merger of the two banks.
The bank said in a statement on Tuesday the management's proposal would be voted on the bank's general shareholders meeting on June 11.
BWR said its shareholders would also vote on the planned merger with Bank Secesyjny SA, which BWR intends to take over by mid-1997.
BWR said 1,977,250 shares would be earmarked for current Secesyjny shareholders and said an exchange of 25 BWR shares for each Secesyjny would be carried out to conclude the merger.
It said between 10,022,750 and 18,022,750 shares would be offered in a public subscription.
It did not give further details.
